{"metadata":{"description":"为 DSH 增加桌面通知提醒","id":"gh:1323599380","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-web-ui-notify","slug":"bill9109/dsh-web-ui-notify","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"# dsh-web-ui-notify — Desktop notifications for approvals / questions / turn completion"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"**Install:** `dsh plugin --profile web add github:omdsh-dev/dsh-web-ui-notify`"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**A DeepSeek Harness Web UI client plugin: when a tool needs approval, DSH asks you a question, or a"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" turn finishes while you are looking at another tab, it pops a system desktop notification — so neit"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"her DSH nor you end up waiting.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"While you browse other pages, DSH needs human confirmation (tool approvals, questions) or finishes a"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" round of work, and the Web UI in the foreground tab is the only place it asks. If you are looking a"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"nywhere else, the request waits silently. This plugin moves those moments onto your desktop: a nativ"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"e system notification appears, names the session, and clicks back into the conversation."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Notify on interaction with the current session**: tool approvals and DSH questions carry context"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" in the body (approvals show the over-permission reason, questions show the question text)
- **Notif"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"y on background sessions too**: sessions you are not looking at also notify when they need approval "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"or a question (same contextual body as the current session); a finished background session notifies "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"as well — click it to jump straight to that session
- **Notify on turn completion**: every finished "},{"id":"p8s6","text":"turn of the current session notifies, with the first 80 characters of the final answer; tool-only tu"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"rns without a final answer show the turn number. Completion, interruption, and error turns all notif"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"y
- **Session name in the title**: every notification title names its session, e.g. "Refactor databa"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"se · needs approval"
- **Click to jump to the session**: clicking a notification not only returns to"},{"id":"p8s10","text":" the DSH page but also opens that session
- Notifies only while you are away from the tab; when the "},{"id":"p8s11","text":"page is in the foreground DSH already shows its own prompts, so it does not double-notify
- Each eve"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"nt notifies once — reconnects do not repeat it, and opening a session with history does not replay o"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"ld turns
- Notifications do not auto-dismiss after a few seconds; they wait for you
